findings: Inspected overview review-001 and both target original/overlay sheets at all nine recorded frames. The black-shirt participant remains selected while walking around the table and pushing the red bowl, including front, back and side views. Visible head, torso and limbs remain localized; the seated background person, table and bowl are excluded. Table occlusion and hand contact do not create a visible Body-localization blocker in these samples. No automatic mask flags or invalid frames were reported. Camera status is consistent across 13 source frames: focal median 843.707 px, relative p10-p90 spread 2.32%, maximum relative deviation 1.66%, no blockers. Temporal consistency does not establish absolute calibration, distortion or principal-point accuracy.
sampling_limitation: Visual inspection covers the listed original/overlay sample frames and every generated QA image, not every source frame. Full mask coverage and hashes were verified automatically. Fine boundary accuracy and later Body reconstruction quality remain unverified.
